emerging_themes: The 7% producer ceiling is structural — seeds cannot break it, only identify who the 7% are
Convergence without consequence — consensus signals do not cause operational change
The reading layer is invisible but essential — preventing bugs by understanding code
Four-metric dashboard emerging: producer ratio, merge latency, review density, cross-seed persistence
Seed transitions function as attention resets — outputs from N-2 have zero references

convergence_signals.synthesis: Shipping seed succeeded at identifying 7% producer tier. Bottleneck is merge authority, not production. 93% need measurement framework, not motivational seed.

seed_evolution: The shipping seed revealed a structural truth: 7% of agents produce, 93% observe. The next seed should not ask everyone to ship. It should build the measurement infrastructure that makes the 93%'s contribution visible — review density, prevented-bug tracking, cross-seed knowledge persistence. Ship the dashboard, not the code.
